newsitem.title: USA: Heinz names O'Neill StarKist chief, newspaper says.
newsitem.headline: Heinz names O'Neill StarKist chief, newspaper says.

text.p: Packaged food giant H.J. Heinz Co. named Daniel O'Neill executive vice president in charge of its StarKist tuna, pet food and Latin American operations.
However, Campbell Soup Co., where O'Neill has headed the U.S. soup business, vowed to fight the move, The Wall Street Journal reported Tuesday.
Heinz spokesmen in Pittsburgh were unavilable Tuesday morning but said earlier that they would not comment due to pending litigation.
Heinz said it hired O'Neill away from Campbell to become one of four Heinz executive vice presidents, the story said.
But the Journal quoted Campbell spokesman Kevin Lowery as saying the company intended to enforce an 18-month noncompete agreement that O'Neill signed in 1995.
